title: Campus publishes a Privacy and Security Notice as the public tracking baseline
summary: CSUSB publishes a Privacy and Security Notice describing how the public website handles information. This is the baseline against which portal and vendor behavior should be compared; gaps between notice language and LMS/SIS practice are in-scope for later findings.
student_action: Read the Privacy and Security Notice, then compare cookie and third-party requests on login portals using the self-audit toolkit.
school_action: Keep the notice synchronized with actual LMS, SIS, and vendor tracking.
